setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays a four-step pattern, C3 D3 E3 F3 (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65) at velocities 127, 117, 107 and 97, through the test MIDI device at 90 BPM with Rate /1 and channel range steps 1-4. The sequencer is stopped and a MIDI keyboard is connected as Mosaic's input. Map scale to white keys is On and the scale is C natural minor. The Scale Editor holds degree II, rotation 2 and global transpose +2, and Honour scale degree is On, so the white keys C3 to C4 play 62, 63, 65, 67, 68, 70, 72, 74. Honour scale rotations and Honour scale transpose are Off.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Tap K1 and open PARAMS > MOSAIC > Midi control. Select Honour scale rotations and turn E3 right to On. The row reads On.
steps.title: Turn on Honour scale rotations

steps.caption: Close the menu and play C3 to C4 again. Rotation 2 turns the top of the scale upside down: the last two white keys before the octave, the A and B keys, sound an octave lower, 58 and 60 instead of 70 and 72, giving 62, 63, 65, 67, 68, 58, 60, 74. The first five keys do not change. Use it to play a bass note or an inverted voicing of the same scale shape from the keys you already know.
steps.title: Rotate the keyboard voicing
